EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows only broad aliphatic C–H stretches at 2879, 2916 and 2937 cm⁻¹ plus a weaker CH₂/CH₃ bending band at 1450 cm⁻¹. No bands for aromatic C=C, C≡C, ring-breathing or other hetero-atom vibrations appear. Candidate 1 (CCCOCCN) is a straight-chain ether-amine containing one CH₃ and four CH₂ groups, so its Raman profile is dominated by CH₂/CH₃ vibrations exactly in this region. It provides the highest CH₂ : CH₃ ratio among the top candidates, matching the strong 2920–2940 cm⁻¹ CH₂ band and the absence of a prominent 2960 cm⁻¹ CH₃ asymmetric stretch, while ring-containing or more CH₃-rich alternatives would likely show additional distinct peaks. Hence candidate 1 best fits the limited experimental evidence.
